contract: Use gzip variants when supported. Local borders, picking and saved local fills use localUrl; landUrl is exact local union. Render fallbackUrl only outside local union when present; countryUrl combines local and fallback for country selection/saved country fills. Hide explicit replaceWorldIds and retain other overview features. IDs and properties except center/bbox are unchanged.
limitations: Historical source years and boundaries are preserved; increased geometric fidelity does not assert current administrative coverage.
Source administrative areas can include water. Land is the local source union, not an independently surveyed coastline.
Overview entities with less than 95% source coverage use an explicit overview-minus-local fallback; their old full fills are replaced to avoid overlapping coarse edges.
